long_biography.plain_text:
Dana graduated from the University of Denver and began his career with Caulkins Oil, observing projects that ranged from energy to resort development. A lifelong sailor, he joined a major competitive-sailing syndicate early in his career and later served as commodore of a leading American sailing club.

When Newport's final working shipyard entered bankruptcy in 1998, Dana assembled partners and bought the property at auction. His family eventually held a controlling stake, while the rebuilt yard developed into a major repair, refit and marina business. Safe Harbor Marinas later acquired it. Dana has since continued philanthropic governance through the Dana Foundation and Dana-Farber Cancer Institute.
